events.title: Risk-aware, explainable fabric inspection
events.body: Actual screen recording of the local application. A trained RAW-FABRID model performs a fresh prediction for each upload. This walkthrough is scripted with browser automation.

events.title: Case 1: annotated defect-free patch
events.body: The publisher annotation is defect-free. Ground truth is supplied only for this demonstration; the application receives the image pixels.

events.title: Prediction and score
events.body: The model predicts defect-free with score 12.5%. The score is not guaranteed confidence. The classification cutoff was selected on validation data.

events.title: Original pixels and the explanation
events.body: Opacity is zero: inspect the original patch. The original image remains available alongside the explanation.

events.title: Grad-CAM of the defect logit
events.body: Bright regions show positive Grad-CAM attribution for the defect logit. Occlusion checks in the report test sensitivity; this is not a certified defect boundary or a causal explanation.

events.title: Human review and limitations
events.body: Inspection bands are validation-selected decision rules with assumed costs. A patch cannot certify a roll. Unseen fabrics, changed lighting, blur and tiny defects can cause errors.

events.title: Invalid inputs are rejected
events.body: This upload contains invalid image bytes. The server rejects it and the interface displays the error. Valid input must be a 256 x 256 PNG or JPEG of at most 5 MiB.

events.title: Evidence and reproducibility
events.body: The report contains the frozen split, actual experiment logs, a shared held-out comparison, and three incorrect predictions analysed with XAI. Model limitations and AI assistance are declared.
